name: corte
description: Create, edit, automate and publish brand media with Corte: images, video and audio in your brand's look, Workflows, content, Build sites, social posts and agent runs.

interface.longDescription:
Corte is an AI media platform: create, edit, automate and publish brand media in one workspace. Connect it and describe the outcome; ChatGPT does the work in your Corte projects.

Create: generate images, video, music, voiceover and sound effects in your brand's look and voice. Run one-click Applications like Product Reshoot and Virtual Try-On on your own photos.

Automate: start any of your Workflows, follow the run, and get the results back.

Publish: get a permanent public link for any asset. Create, translate and publish content. Spin up a Build site or app, talk to it, and deploy it.

Grow: draft social posts and campaigns for review, and see how they performed. A person approves or schedules social posts in Corte before anything is sent to a connected channel. Turn a product catalog into ready-to-run ads.

Follow your agents: see what your Corte agents did on each run and what they made.

Stay in control: everything lands in the project you choose, and shared projects bill the project owner. You approve exactly what ChatGPT can reach when you connect, and you can disconnect it anytime from Corte's Settings.
defaultPrompt: Make a product photo of my mug on a linen tablecloth in soft morning light
Turn my latest product photo into a five-second product video
Draft a journal post for my site about setting an autumn table

positive.prompt: Make a product photo of a handmade ceramic mug on a linen tablecloth in soft morning light, square format.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts an image generation in the account's default project and shows the finished image inline, with a link to it in the Corte library.

positive.prompt: Show me the images in my Corte library.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's stored images (the Hearthen mug, bowl, vase and plates) and renders them as a grid.

positive.prompt: Turn my vase photo into a short product video with a slow push-in.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the vase image, starts a video generation using it as the first frame, and returns the finished clip with a library link.

positive.prompt: Draft a journal post for my Hearthen site about setting an autumn table, and save it as a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an unpublished journal document with a title and body in the account's content, and reports its title and id.

positive.prompt: Run my Lifestyle scenes workflow on the mug photo and show me the results.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the Lifestyle scenes workflow with the mug image as its input and shows the generated scenes when the run finishes.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to media
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Coding help unrelated to the user's Corte account
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a linked list.

negative.description: Travel booking, which Corte does not do
negative.prompt: Find me a cheap flight from New York to Lisbon next Friday.

publication.release_notes: First release: create images, video and audio; run Applications and Workflows; manage content, Build sites and social posts; follow your agents' runs in Corte.
